app.name: PUMA | Shop Clothes & Trainers
app.description: Shop the latest PUMA clothes, trainers, and accessories with personalised recommendations, virtual try-on, and exclusive app-only offers.

verdict.one_liner: PUMA collects shopping and device data for personalisation and ads, shares it with retargeting partners, and uses fingerprinting—though it offers better data rights than many shopping apps.
verdict.summary: PUMA's shopping app is a GDPR-compliant fashion retail app with transparent data practices. It collects standard purchase and device data, uses your camera for virtual try-on, and tracks your behaviour with cookies and fingerprinting for analytics and retargeting. The app shares data with service providers including retargeting partners and social media platforms, and stores data for up to 10 years for legal compliance. On the positive side, it offers clear data subject rights (access, erasure, export), anonymises IP addresses, and lets you withdraw analytics consent in app settings.
verdict.recommendation_reason: While PUMA provides better transparency and data rights than many shopping apps, it still uses fingerprinting, retargeting, and broad analytics tracking that may be excessive for casual shopping.

red.title: Uses device fingerprinting for tracking
red.plain_english: PUMA explicitly uses fingerprinting technology to recognise your device and track your actions across app sessions, making it harder to avoid tracking even if you clear cookies.

red.title: Shares data with retargeting partners
red.plain_english: Your shopping behaviour and personal data are shared with retargeting providers who show you ads on other websites and apps based on what you looked at in the PUMA app.

red.title: Data shared with linked social media platforms
red.plain_english: PUMA shares your data with social media platforms it is linked with, which can use this information to build advertising profiles about you.

red.title: Keeps your data for up to 10 years
red.plain_english: PUMA stores your personal data for up to 10 years to comply with commercial and tax laws, meaning your information remains on their systems long after you stop using the app.

green.title: Clear data subject rights available
green.plain_english: You can request access to, correction of, erasure of, or export of your personal data by emailing PUMA. They also have a grievance officer you can contact.

green.title: Analytics consent can be withdrawn
green.plain_english: You can withdraw your consent for analytics tracking at any time in your app account settings. If you do, PUMA will only analyse your use on an anonymous, aggregated basis.

green.title: IP addresses are anonymised
green.plain_english: PUMA shortens your IP address immediately after collection so it cannot be connected back to you, which limits location-based profiling.

green.title: App permissions are user-controllable
green.plain_english: You can change push notification, camera, and location permissions at any time through your app account settings or your phone's system settings.

green.title: Uses EU Standard Contractual Clauses
green.plain_english: When sharing your data with service providers outside the EU, PUMA uses legally binding EU Standard Contractual Clauses to protect your data.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The app asks for camera access to power the Virtual Try-On feature and to scan barcodes when searching. You can turn this off in your device settings.
categories.detail: Camera is used for Virtual Try-On (foot detection with 3D shoe overlay) and barcode scanning. No mention of storing images or videos on servers.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you use the Virtual Try-On feature, PUMA SE will ask you to access your camera to detect your foot and overlay the 3D model of the shoe.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The app asks for your location to show nearby stores, and also collects your geographical location for analytics and personalised content.
categories.detail: Geolocation requested for store locator. Geographical location also collected for analytics (with consent) and personalisation.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you use the store locator, PUMA SE will ask you to access your geolocation to display stores that are close to your current location.

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention any access to your contacts or phonebook.
categories.detail: No contact or phonebook access is described in the policy.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention any access to your phone's files or storage.
categories.detail: No storage or file access is described in the policy.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Your data is shared with app service providers, CRM and analytics companies, retargeting partners, linked social media platforms, and selected PUMA Group employees.
categories.detail: Sharing with service providers (development, CRM, analytics, retargeting), social media platforms, and PUMA Group employees on need-to-know basis. Legal sharing with courts and authorities.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our service providers who are involved in the development and provision of the App and its functionalities, our CRM system provider as well as our service analytics and retargeting providers and linked social media platforms.

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: PUMA collects your name, contact details, gender, age range, and app store account ID when you register or make purchases.
categories.detail: Standard account data including name, email, phone, address, gender, age range, and unique app store account ID. Used for account management and personalisation.
categories.policy_excerpt: Registration and management of a customer account... Gender and age range... Your unique app store account ID.

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: PUMA tracks every click, cart addition, purchase, and app interaction using cookies, pixels, and fingerprinting. This data is used for personalised recommendations, retargeting, and marketing.
categories.detail: Extensive behavioural tracking via cookies, pixels, fingerprinting, scripts. Tracks usage events, cart/purchase events, referral data, gender, age, location, device language. Used for analytics, retargeting, and customised shopping experience.
categories.policy_excerpt: Cookie or similar identifier... Usage events (e.g. when you click on certain a product)... Cart and Purchase events... Referral data and traffic events... Gender and age range... cookies and other similar technologies (e.g. scripts, pixels or fingerprinting).

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention any specific protections for children's data or a minimum age requirement.
categories.detail: No mention of children, minors, or age restrictions in the policy. GDPR-based structure implies 16+ but not stated explicitly.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: PUMA logs your IP address (shortened for anonymity), browser type, operating system, network provider, country code, and the web pages you visit before and after using the app.
categories.detail: Network logging includes IP address (anonymised), URL, browser type/version, OS, network provider, country code. Log files kept for 90 days.
categories.policy_excerpt: The complete Uniform Resource Locator (URL)... IP address (immediately anonymised by shortening the IP address)... Type and version of browser... Network provider/ network/ country code.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: PUMA collects detailed device information and explicitly uses fingerprinting technology to recognise your device across sessions for tracking and advertising.
categories.detail: Device type, name, manufacturer, OS, browser, language, cookie ID collected. Fingerprinting explicitly listed as a tracking technology alongside cookies, scripts, and pixels.
categories.policy_excerpt: Device type, device name, device manufacturer and device language... cookies and other similar technologies (e.g. scripts, pixels or fingerprinting).

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention any collection of health or biometric data. The Virtual Try-On camera feature appears to process foot detection on your device without storing biometric information.
categories.detail: Virtual Try-On uses camera for on-device 3D overlay. No mention of storing or processing biometric data.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: PUMA collects payment information when you buy products and digital gift cards, but the policy does not clearly state whether card details are stored or passed to a payment processor.
categories.detail: Payment data collected for purchases and digital gift cards. No explicit mention of third-party payment processors or whether card details are stored.
categories.policy_excerpt: Purchase and payment of products... Purchase and payment of digital gift cards.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can request access to, correction of, erasure of, or export of your data by emailing PUMA. They also have a grievance officer. However, some data may be kept for up to 10 years for legal reasons.
categories.detail: Data subject rights include access, rectification, erasure, restriction, export. Contact via shopping-app@puma.com. Grievance officer available. Data retained for legal/statutory periods up to 10 years.
categories.policy_excerpt: provide you with information on your personal data that we process, rectify any of your personal data, erase, restrict and/or export any of your personal data stored on our systems, address any grievances you may have.
concerns: Data retained for up to 10 years

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: PUMA can change its privacy policy at any time without advance warning. The updated policy applies as soon as it is published on the app.
categories.detail: No advance notice mechanism. Changes apply from publication time. Users expected to check periodically. No explicit re-consent required.
categories.policy_excerpt: We reserve the right to supplement and modify the content of this Data Processing Information. The updated Data Processing Information applies from the time, in which it was published on this application.
